LanguageData.HD_PowerCutter_Breach_Desc: Cut through an impassable wall or door without recovering materials. Player-owned structures are breached 50% faster than normal deconstruction. Other structures take longer according to their remaining hit points, with diminishing time increases at high durability.
LanguageData.HD_PowerCutter_Breach_Unavailable: The power cutter cannot be used right now.
LanguageData.HD_PowerCutter_Breach_InvalidTarget: Select an impassable wall or a door.
LanguageData.HD_PowerCutter_Breach_CannotReserve: The selected structure is already reserved.
